subject.title: fix: add exact and prefix skill search modes

question: Should ClawHub permanently expose `mode=prefix` and `mode=exact`, matching CLI flags, and a 200-result cap as its public registry-discovery contract?
rationale: The branch adds durable public HTTP and CLI surface plus a new limit policy; implementation review cannot determine that product contract without maintainer intent.

options.title: Accept both modes
options.body: Adopt exact and prefix modes as the supported deterministic discovery contract after fixing OpenAPI coverage and supplying real backend proof.

options.title: Ship prefix only
options.body: Address the linked enumeration need while continuing to use existing inspection workflows for exact-slug lookup.

options.title: Defer the contract
options.body: Keep ranked search unchanged until maintainers design a broader listing and pagination API.

recommendation.title: Accept both modes
recommendation.body: Adopt exact and prefix modes as the supported deterministic discovery contract after fixing OpenAPI coverage and supplying real backend proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent work on the digest-backed search path makes them the strongest available owner for evaluating the backend contract and implementation direction.
